2.  Create an `HTTPRoute` named `app-route`.
3.  Configure the `HTTPRoute` to route `host: app.example.com` and `path: /app` (PathPrefix) to `Service: app` on `port: 80`.

```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: app-gateway
spec:
  gatewayClassName: traefik
  listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 8000
```

### HTTPRoute Definition
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: app-route
spec:
  hostNames:
    - app.example.com
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /app
      backend:
        service:
          name: app
          port:
            number: 80
```
